classification.difficultyReason: Prepare each angle calculation using geometric information: construct an altitude in an isosceles triangle, transfer an angle across parallel lines, or convert an interior angle to its exterior supplement.

content.prompt: Find the angle $\theta$ in these diagrams. Answer to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Inverted isosceles triangle with matching double ticks on the sloping sides and the interior angle at the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Top side 4 cm; each equal sloping side 5 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; no altitude or answer supplied.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the lower vertex to the midpoint of the top side. Each half of the top side is $2\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{2}{5}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)\\\theta&\approx66.4218215^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx66^{\circ}25'\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle with a right angle at the right-hand vertex. The left side extends above the upper-left vertex, where the exterior angle is marked.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular sides 1.7 m and 3.8 m; theta is supplementary to the upper-left interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens and exterior angle label only.

answer.worked:
Let $\alpha$ be the interior angle adjacent to $\theta$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\alpha&=\frac{3.8}{1.7}\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3.8}{1.7}\right)\\\theta&=180^{\circ}-\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{3.8}{1.7}\right)\\\theta&\approx114.1022345^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx114^{\circ}6'\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle with horizontal top side and a diagonal hypotenuse. Parallel upward arrow cues identify both vertical lines; theta is between the diagonal and the downward right vertical.
spec.mathematics: Top side 1.8 mm; hypotenuse 3.4 mm; the two vertical lines are parallel.

answer.worked:
The lower-left interior angle equals $\theta$ because the vertical lines are parallel.
$$\begin{align*}\sin\theta&=\frac{1.8}{3.4}\\\theta&=\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1.8}{3.4}\right)\\\theta&\approx31.9657188^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx31^{\circ}58'\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with dashed perpendicular altitude, equal base halves, and a dimension arrow spanning the complete base.
spec.mathematics: Whole base 50; altitude 20; equal base halves.
spec.answerVisibility: No half-base value or angle answer supplied.

answer.worked:
Each half of the base is $50\div2=25$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{20}{25}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{20}{25}\right)\\\theta&\approx38.6598083^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx38^{\circ}40'\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Right triangle inscribed in a circle. Its hypotenuse passes through the marked centre. The label 6 belongs to the lower-left-to-centre radius.
spec.mathematics: Radius 6; adjacent chord 7; hypotenuse is the diameter.
spec.answerVisibility: Diameter value and angle answer are not supplied.

spec.description: Upright isosceles triangle with matching double ticks and theta at the left base vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: No altitude, half-base value or angle answer supplied.

answer.worked:
Draw a perpendicular from the apex to the midpoint of the base. Each half of the base is $10\div2=5$.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{5}{15}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{15}\right)\\\theta&\approx70.5287794^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx70^{\circ}32'\end{align*}$$
